title: Accessible Multi-Select Tag Combobox with Live Region
purpose: Test strict WCAG AA/AAA compliance, focus trapping, and ARIA 1.2 combobox pattern.
brief: Build a fully accessible headless multi-select autocomplete tag component compliant with WAI-ARIA 1.2 Combobox pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Complete ARIA combobox markup (role="combobox", aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-activedescendant)
Full keyboard navigation (ArrowDown/Up navigation, Enter selection, Escape close, Backspace chip removal)
Dynamic aria-live region announcing filtered count and active item updates
Visible high-contrast focus rings on all interactive tags and inputs
Zero keyboard traps; clean tab order restoration on blur
